verdict.reasons: The image accurately depicts the correct product family (AFP tape20 drip-tape carton roll) with highly legible, authentic, and correctly rendered branding, including the Persian text and the required watermark. The scene is professionally integrated into an agricultural setting with neutral seedlings and installed laterals, showing excellent visual coherence with no geometric artifacts or AI distortions. Minor deductions are applied only for slight, non-core visual softness or texture inconsistencies in the soil background, which do not affect the core product identity or overall article suitability. All advisory clearance and framing guidelines are respected.

focused_physical_review.reason: The primary white-and-blue package sits in the foreground with the nearest irrigation line terminating or passing behind its immediate footprint; consequently, a broad uninterrupted soil gap is not visible around the complete base or rear of the carton. No irrigation line emerges from, crosses, or reappears behind the package on the same axis. No distinct additional loose coils or rolls are present outside the main package. Inspection of the sides and base reveals no protruding white ribbons, straps, or tape tails.
